name: Starship
description: The biggest rocket ever flown: 33 Raptors on the Super Heavy booster, six on the ship. The booster comes back to be caught by the tower.
notes: Masses are best public estimates; SpaceX changes Starship often.
The real ship lights its engines before letting go of the booster (hot staging); the sim separates first.
The booster flies back to the launch tower to be caught; the sim brings it down wherever it falls.
Getting to the Moon needs refuelling in orbit, which the sim doesn't model, so this flight stops in orbit.
